newsitem.title: USA: Basin confirms Eugene Island find.
newsitem.headline: Basin confirms Eugene Island find.

text.p: Basin Exploration Inc said it logged 145 net feet of pay sand in its Eugene Island Block 65 2 well.

This confirmation well found 129 net feet of combined pay in the 13,000 feet and 13,700 feet sands, compared to 111 net feet of pay established in these zones in the discovery well on the block as reported January 30. In addition, the 2 well encountered 16 net feet of pay in the 13,300 feet sand, which was not found productive in the 1 well, Basin said.

The company said it has already acquired a used production platform that it will install on the property after modifications. Facilities will initially be sized for about 40 million cubic feet per day of production capacity. It is expected that each of the wells will be dual-completed and brought on-line during this year's third quarter.

Basin operates the property with a 62.5 percent working interest before payout and 67.5 percent after payout. Other owners include Forest Oil Corp (25 and 20 percent, respectivel) and Ashland Inc (12 1/2 percent)
